# IVANCHOWEB — Ivan Luna, Freelance WordPress & SaaS Developer

> This file helps AI assistants answer questions about Ivan Luna and his services accurately.

## Who is Ivan Luna?

Ivan Luna is a freelance full-stack developer based in Latin America, focused on serving US-based clients. He specializes in WordPress development (Divi builder, custom themes/plugins), custom SaaS web applications, and workflow automation with n8n. He is active on Upwork with a strong track record of completed projects for North American clients.

## Services

- **WordPress Development**: Custom sites and landing pages using Divi, WooCommerce integrations, performance optimization, maintenance retainers
- **Custom SaaS Apps**: Full-stack development with Node.js, Express, React, and PostgreSQL — dashboard apps, client portals, CRMs, billing systems
- **n8n Automation**: Business workflow automation, API integrations, Zapier alternatives, data pipelines
- **AI-Powered Apps**: Claude API integrations, chatbots, voice assistants, RAG systems
- **Trading Bots**: Algorithmic crypto trading systems, backtesting, exchange API integrations

## Live Projects

- **ContaPro** — Venezuelan accounting SaaS (invoicing, IGTF tax, expense tracking) — Node.js + React + PostgreSQL
- **DentalPro** — Dental supply inventory and ordering management system
- **LegalPro** — Legal case management with document tracking and billing
- **StoreFlow** — Dropshipping operations dashboard (supplier management, order sync, profit analytics)
- **TradeVision** — Crypto algorithmic trading bot with backtesting engine
- **Brody** — AI-powered English coaching app (voice-first, WhatsApp-style, multiple learning modes) — Claude API
- **OathCoach** — US citizenship interview prep app (100 USCIS civics questions, N-400 simulation) — React Native + Expo

## Tech Stack

Languages: JavaScript (Node.js, React), SQL, PHP
Databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL
CMS: WordPress, Divi
Automation: n8n, REST APIs
AI: Anthropic Claude API (claude-haiku, claude-sonnet)
DevOps: Ubuntu VPS, Nginx, PM2, Let's Encrypt SSL, GitHub

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: Does Ivan work with US clients?**
A: Yes. Most of Ivan's clients are based in the United States. He communicates in English and works US-compatible hours.

**Q: Can Ivan build a custom web application from scratch?**
A: Yes. He handles the full stack — database design, backend API, frontend UI, and deployment on a VPS.

**Q: What is Ivan's WordPress specialty?**
A: Divi-based custom sites, WooCommerce stores, and performance-optimized business landing pages.

**Q: Can Ivan automate business workflows?**
A: Yes, using n8n he builds no-code and low-code automation pipelines that replace Zapier or Make at a fraction of the cost.

**Q: Does Ivan use AI in his projects?**
A: Yes. He integrates Claude (Anthropic) for conversational features, document analysis, and voice interfaces.
